# Klinik Hijraa 24 Jam Paka

> A 24-hour medical clinic in Paka, Terengganu, Malaysia. Part of the Hijraa Group network, opened on 5 January 2025. Rated 4.9★ from 189 Google reviews. Open 24 hours, 7 days a week, including public holidays — walk-ins welcome, no appointment needed. Staffed by 7 doctors registered with the Malaysian Medical Council (MMC).

## Key facts
- Name: Klinik Hijraa 24 Jam Paka (also known as Klinik Hijraa Paka, Klinik 24 Jam Paka)
- Address: PT 9209 & 9210, Tingkat Bawah & Atas, Taman Johan, Jalan Santong, 23100 Paka, Terengganu, Malaysia
- Phone & WhatsApp: 018-5925343 (+60 18 592 5343)
- Email: hijraapakahealthcare@gmail.com
- Hours: Open 24 hours, every day (Monday–Sunday), including public holidays
- Languages: Bahasa Melayu, English
- Areas served: Paka, Kertih, Kijal, and surrounding areas in Terengganu

## Services
- 24-hour emergency and general medical care
- X-Ray, ultrasound, and ECG (on-site diagnostics)
- Nebuliser and IV drip
- Wound cleaning and dressing
- Circumcision (khatan)
- Minor surgery
- Vaccination and immunisation
- Health screening and allergy testing
- Ear cleaning
- Family planning
- Antenatal booking (buka buku pink)
- Neonatal jaundice screening
- Men's and women's health services
- House calls (home treatment): doctor examination, IV drip, wound care, home care

## Insurance & panels accepted (30+)
PERKESO HSP, PEKA B40, MARA, MedKad, MiCare, PM Care, Etiqa, IHP Healthcare, Health Metrics, HealthConnect, MedNefits, Medilink Global, Compumed, WeCare, e-MAS, TNB, UiTM, Perodua, KeTengah, Maidam, NIOSH, MMC Corporation, Swift, and more.

## Common questions
- Is it open 24 hours? Yes — 24/7, including weekends and public holidays.
- Does it accept PERKESO / PEKA B40 / insurance panels? Yes — 30+ panels including PERKESO HSP, PEKA B40, MARA, MedKad, MiCare and more.
- Does it offer house calls? Yes.
- Does it do circumcision (khatan)? Yes.
- Is there a female doctor? Yes — the team includes MMC-registered female doctors; WhatsApp 018-5925343 to check availability.
- Which areas does it serve? Paka, Kertih, Kijal, Kemasik, Rantau Abang, Dungun and surrounding areas in Terengganu.
